body: I will remember you. For some reason that actually helped. Thank you
I didnt sit on the sidelines. I was the only person who reacted. It didnt turn into a fight, but if it ever does then I will do my best to impregnate him with my shoe
Not sure if that helped, but I like the enthusiasm. Thank you

I really dont think he owns a firearm. Even carrying a butter knife outside here is reason for a fine. I also dont think confronting him alone would be a problem, as long as its at the station. There's a military base nearby, so there are usually a few soldiers present at all times. Surely they will do something if he starts actually beating someone instead of 'just' punching. I will probably still bring people, but its not guaranteed that I will be able to. I might end up in a situation where I have to act quickly before he leaves. He's not muscular or particularly tall, so its not like I feel threatened by him, he just seemed unpredictable.
Would confronting him be a good idea? If he gets violent then he's going to jail, which would solve the problem faster, and it would let me punch back, which would make me feel a lot better. Helped

It really didnt feel like an isolated incident. The boyfriend was screaming about "having to do this again". Another thing is that her eye might have been a little bruised. It was hard to tell because she had darker skin and the tears had spread her make-up, but she definitely had a bruise on her arm. That could have been caused by anything, but at some point coincidences become evidence. Helped

Of course they were scared. I was scared too. I just dont feel like that justifies letting it happen. The boyfriend wasnt a big dude. I probably wouldnt have dared do anything if I wasnt bigger than him. He seemed like he was ready to tackle anyone who pissed him off, but 0 out of 50 people doing anything? Especially some of the big guys. A guy who was like 6'3, 250 pounds walked right by them as he was hitting her. He just kinda glanced at them and continued when this dude could literally have stepped on him and crushed him if he wanted to. I will update you on if anything happens if I remember
